$comment: Every message lookup in the federation bundles that the literal key scan cannot account for: a computed key, the facade renamed or imported as a namespace, or the facade handed to another function. Each names the key families it can produce. Maintained by hand: vite.federation-catalog.ts fails the build on an undeclared or stale entry, and the generator never writes this file.
